Asclepius: A Spectrum Evaluation Benchmark for Medical Multi-Modal Large Language Models
record.reason: Evaluates medical multimodal models across 15 clinical specialties and diagnostic tasks; medicine is the benchmark objective.

record.title: Beyond True or False: Retrieval-Augmented Hierarchical Analysis of Nuanced Claims
record.reason: General nuanced-claim analysis is the primary objective. Section 4.1/Table 1 evaluates World Relations (140 claims; 9,525 papers) and Biomedical (50 claims; 3,719 papers). Biomedical evidence is a substantial secondary application, but the general cross-domain method and predominantly nonmedical corpus do not establish a medical/biomedical-primary study. Exclusion is based on objective and study balance, not generic methodology alone.

record.title: Boosting LLM’s Molecular Structure Elucidation with Knowledge Enhanced Tree Search Reasoning
record.reason: Primary objective is general chemical molecular-structure elucidation from spectra. Section 5.1 tests 216 MolPuzzle molecules from IR, carbon/proton NMR and molecular formula; the reviewed objective and experiment do not establish drug, protein, gene, cell, or other biomedical-primary research. Do not classify all chemistry as biomedical merely because molecules are involved.

record.title: CAMI: A Counselor Agent Supporting Motivational Interviewing through State Inference and Topic Exploration
record.reason: Mental-health counseling via motivational interviewing is the stated objective and the focus of automatic and expert evaluations.

record.title: CheXalign: Preference fine-tuning in chest X-ray interpretation models without human feedback
record.reason: Chest X-ray report generation is the primary task; MIMIC-CXR and additional medical perception/reasoning tasks drive evaluation.

record.title: Completing A Systematic Review in Hours instead of Months with Interactive AI Agents
record.reason: Although its agent architecture is general, the actual study is healthcare-primary: Section 4.1 uses 15 systematic reviews and nine medical experts; Appendix D/Table 6 lists clinical, nursing, treatment and health reviews. Medical evidence synthesis is substantive throughout.

record.title: Consistent Client Simulation for Motivational Interviewing-based Counseling
record.reason: Simulates clients for mental-health counseling, with client motivation, beliefs, receptivity and counseling-session consistency evaluated automatically and by experts.

record.title: Data-Constrained Synthesis of Training Data for De-Identification
record.reason: Domain adaptation, synthetic corpora and NER evaluations all target privacy-preserving de-identification of clinical text in Swedish and Spanish.

record.title: DDxTutor: Clinical Reasoning Tutoring System with Differential Diagnosis-Based Structured Reasoning
record.reason: Clinical diagnostic education is the primary objective; evaluates structured reasoning and tutoring with 933 doctor-verified cases and medical educators/students.

record.title: Delta-KNN: Improving Demonstration Selection in In-Context Learning for Alzheimer’s Disease Detection
record.reason: Alzheimer disease detection from patient-generated text is the objective and the evaluation uses two Alzheimer detection datasets.

Dialogue Systems for Emotional Support via Value Reinforcement
record.reason: Emotional-distress reduction and value reinforcement are the primary objectives, evaluated on support skills, emotional intensity and therapist feedback.

record.title: Efficient Domain Continual pretraining by Mitigating the Stability Gap
record.reason: Medical continual pretraining is the main empirical study: Section 4.2/Table 1 evaluates PubMedQA, MedMCQA, MedQA and medical MMLU topics; law-domain transfer is relegated to Appendix F. General training methodology is not an exclusion when the main study is medical.

record.title: Flipping Knowledge Distillation: Leveraging Small Models’ Expertise to Enhance LLMs in Text Matching
record.reason: Generic text matching is the primary objective. Section 4.1 evaluates financial ATEC, medical NFCorpus and a ByteDance customer-service dataset covering payments, subscriptions, insurance and loans. Medical retrieval is one secondary benchmark, not a medical-primary study.

record.title: Follow-up Question Generation For Enhanced Patient-Provider Conversations
record.reason: Primary task is follow-up question generation from patient messages and EHRs, evaluated on real/synthetic medical conversations and clinically written questions.

record.title: GeLLM³O: Generalizing Large Language Models for Multi-property Molecule Optimization
record.reason: Section 3 defines hit-to-lead drug optimization and explicitly constructs tasks around therapeutic goals, intestinal absorption, toxicity, blood-brain barrier permeability and drug-likeness. This is drug-discovery research, not generic chemical captioning.

record.title: GraphCheck: Breaking Long-Term Text Barriers with Extracted Knowledge Graph-Powered Fact-Checking
record.reason: Primary objective is general long-text fact checking. Section 4.1/Table 2 uses generic MiniCheck training and evaluates four general benchmarks plus three medical benchmarks; medical safety is motivation and a secondary application rather than the primary study.

record.title: Hanging in the Balance: Pivotal Moments in Crisis Counseling Conversations
record.reason: The method is developed and validated through crisis-counseling conversations, counselor response timing and subsequent session outcomes.

record.title: If Eleanor Rigby Had Met ChatGPT: A Study on Loneliness in a Post-LLM World
record.reason: Loneliness and mental-health risks in user-ChatGPT conversations are the primary empirical subject, including failures in sensitive psychological scenarios.

record.title: Improving Automatic Evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs) in Biomedical Relation Extraction via LLMs-as-the-Judge
record.reason: The complete study evaluates automated judgment for biomedical relation extraction across three biomedical datasets and proposes structured output/domain adaptation.

record.title: Inferring from Logits: Exploring Best Practices for Decoding-Free Generative Candidate Selection
record.reason: Primary research objective is a general evaluation of decoding-free candidate-selection methods. Sections 4.1.1–4.1.2 give five general QA tasks and four clinical tasks as contrasting candidate-pool regimes. Clinical decisions are substantial testbeds, but no medical-primary objective or predominant medical study is established.

record.title: IRIS: Interpretable Retrieval-Augmented Classification for Long Interspersed Document Sequences
record.reason: Clinical long-history disease prediction is central to the motivation and tailored evaluation, not incidental: Section 4 uses MIMIC-IV hypertension plus purpose-built early ADHD and autism EHR cohorts; general IMDb/Hyperpartisan/arXiv benchmarks serve as standard comparisons.

record.title: Just a Scratch: Enhancing LLM Capabilities for Self-harm Detection through Intent Differentiation and Emoji Interpretation
record.reason: Self-harm detection and mental-health support are the explicit primary task, with intent/emoji annotation resources and self-harm prediction evaluations.

record.title: Less for More: Enhanced Feedback-aligned Mixed LLMs for Molecule Caption Generation and Fine-Grained NLI Evaluation
record.reason: Primary subject is general molecule-caption generation and chemical-domain evaluation. Appendix D confirms L+M-24 covers biomedical, light/electricity, human interaction/organoleptics, and agriculture/industry categories; evaluation randomly samples this broad corpus rather than a biomedical-primary subset.

record.title: Less is More: Explainable and Efficient ICD Code Prediction with Clinical Entities
record.reason: Predicting medical ICD codes from clinical summaries is the primary task, evaluated on MIMIC-IV with clinically annotated entities and assertions.

record.title: LLM Agents Making Agent Tools
record.reason: Although tool generation is generic, its scientific motivation and empirical benchmark are predominantly biomedical: Table 2 has six pathology tasks, two radiology tasks, two omics tasks, plus medical simulation and retinal-feature tasks among fifteen total. Biomedical analysis is the main study balance.

record.title: LLMs Can Simulate Standardized Patients via Agent Coevolution
record.reason: Standardized-patient simulation for medical personnel training is the primary purpose and all evaluation concerns diagnostic dialogues and patient-role requirements.

record.title: MEDDxAgent: A Unified Modular Agent Framework for Explainable Automatic Differential Diagnosis
record.reason: Interactive differential diagnosis is the primary task, with history taking, medical retrieval and diagnosis strategies evaluated across respiratory, skin and rare diseases.

record.title: Medical Graph RAG: Evidence-based Medical Large Language Model via Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
record.reason: The framework is designed for evidence-based medical answers and evaluated on nine medical QA benchmarks, two health fact-checking datasets and medical long-form generation.

record.title: MolRAG: Unlocking the Power of Large Language Models for Molecular Property Prediction
record.reason: Section 4.1 and Tables 1–2 show bioactivity, toxicity and pharmacokinetic tasks dominate the molecular evaluation: BACE, HIV, MUV, Tox21, ToxCast, BBBP and CYP450, with physicochemical tasks as additional comparisons.

record.title: PsyDial: A Large-scale Long-term Conversational Dataset for Mental Health Support
record.reason: Privacy-preserving reconstruction of mental-health counseling dialogues and improvement of counseling responses are the primary contribution and evaluation.

record.title: Query-driven Document-level Scientific Evidence Extraction from Biomedical Studies
record.reason: The primary objective is extracting scientific evidence for clinical research questions with conflicting findings. The CochraneForest dataset and URCA experiments use biomedical studies and Cochrane systematic reviews throughout.

record.title: RARE: Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning Enhancement for Large Language Models
record.reason: Included after focused review: although the framework also targets commonsense reasoning, medical QA is an explicit primary contribution in the Introduction, not an incidental benchmark. Sections 4.1–4.5 evaluate three medical QA datasets alongside three commonsense datasets, run component ablations on 250 MedQA examples, and validate factuality using 10 MedQA questions with two USMLE-qualified medical experts. The study has a substantial general-domain arm, but the medical objective, domain-specific retrieval resources, ablation, and expert evaluation establish a medical-primary research component.

record.title: ReflecTool: Towards Reflection-Aware Tool-Augmented Clinical Agents
record.reason: Clinical agents are the stated objective and complete empirical focus. ClinicalAgent Bench contains 18 tasks across five realistic clinical dimensions; the proposed tool-augmented reflective agent is evaluated on those clinical tasks.

record.title: STRICTA: Structured Reasoning in Critical Text Assessment for Peer Review and Beyond
record.reason: Although STRICTA is a general framework for critical text assessment, its primary empirical study is biomedical paper assessment: Section 4 and Table 1 report 4,371 reasoning-step answers over 22 biomedical papers, collected with biomedical researchers and students, and the LLM-assistance experiments use that corpus. Section 6 adds a smaller formative NLP-domain transfer study; it does not displace the biomedical study as the main empirical contribution.

record.title: Structural Reasoning Improves Molecular Understanding of LLM
record.reason: The primary objective is general chemical molecular-structure reasoning. Introduction and Sections 4.1–4.3 evaluate molecule-to-text, text-to-molecule, and retrosynthesis on L+M, ChEBI-20, and Mol-Instructions using structural/text similarity and molecular validity metrics. A toxicity illustration and biochemical-source dataset do not establish a drug, protein, gene, cell, disease, or other biomedical-primary objective or endpoint. Exclusion is based on the chemical study objective, not on generic methodology.

record.title: Substance over Style: Evaluating Proactive Conversational Coaching Agents
record.reason: Included as behavioral-health coaching research after focused PDF review. Sections 1–2 ground agent design in 11 health coaches across sleep, fitness and life coaching. Section 6.1 evaluates 31 users in 155 conversations selected from behavioral-health scenarios; Appendix A.5/Table 6 includes sleep, weight/exercise, habits, mental well-being, and multi-goal self-care. Health coaching is the actual study setting, despite broad conversational-design lessons and some everyday-life scenarios.

record.title: Temporal reasoning for timeline summarisation in social media
record.reason: Included after objective and study-balance review: the method and training datasets are general temporal-reasoning/news resources, but the downstream target and sole summary evaluation are mental-health timeline summaries. Section 4.1 specifies 30 TalkLife timelines with summaries covering diagnoses, intra/interpersonal patterns, and mental-state changes; Sections 4.2–4.3 evaluate these mental-health summaries. The biomedical application is the primary evaluated use, not an incidental extra benchmark.

record.title: Temporal Relation Extraction in Clinical Texts: A Span-based Graph Transformer Approach
record.reason: The research directly targets extracting clinical events and temporal relations. The main evaluation uses the i2b2 2012 clinical Temporal Relations corpus and the generalization evaluation uses the E3C clinical corpus.

record.title: Towards Omni-RAG: Comprehensive Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Large Language Models in Medical Applications
record.reason: The stated objective is improving medical knowledge acquisition and medical applications of LLMs. The MedOmniKB repository and source-planning optimization experiments focus on diverse medical knowledge sources.

record.title: VISA: Retrieval Augmented Generation with Visual Source Attribution
record.reason: The primary objective is general visual source attribution for retrieval-augmented generation. Section 3.3 and Table 1 establish parallel Wiki-VISA general-knowledge and Paper-VISA medical-document benchmarks (3,000 and 2,160 test cases), plus FineWeb-VISA general-web training data. The experiments assess answer and bounding-box attribution across both domains; medical papers provide one document-format/domain testbed rather than a medical/biomedical-primary research objective.

record.title: VITAL: A New Dataset for Benchmarking Pluralistic Alignment in Healthcare
record.reason: Healthcare pluralistic alignment is the explicit primary objective: 13.1k health value situations and 5.4k health multiple-choice questions evaluated across eight LLMs.

record.title: WhiSPA: Semantically and Psychologically Aligned Whisper with Self-Supervised Contrastive and Student-Teacher Learning
record.reason: Section 3 trains and evaluates on psychiatric-outpatient HiTOP interviews and clinic interviews of WTC responders; downstream outcomes are PTSD and psychopathology scales. The speech-representation method is medical/mental-health primary.
